title: Give each class a clear job
summary: A class is easier to understand when it has one clear job. A basket can add prices without also drawing the whole web page.
introduction: A class is easier to understand when it has one clear job. A basket can add prices without also drawing the whole web page. We will use a small example so you can follow each step.
learningObjectives: Explain give each class a clear job
Use the example to answer a practice question

blocks.title: Give each class a clear job

blocks.text: The result is 7. Basket handles prices; another part of the app can show the total.

blocks.title: A common mistake
blocks.text: A class with many unrelated jobs becomes hard to change and test.
